description: Minecraft mode: an agent's servers become mc-<n>, numbered fleet-wide, laid out in their own image of square tiles and never on the wall. minecraft_reset restores one server (once per 2 s per client) or every free one (once per 10 s per client); minecraft_fork copies a running server into the next running, unlent server on its host (once per 10 s per client), timed from the click to the copy's first chunk; claim_minecraft lends one (one per client, a cap of 2 or half the servers, a cooldown) and names its viewer as the server's driver; the end of a borrow and a viewer leaving each reset the server. Every intent refuses an argument it does not take.

expect.note: an agent's servers become mc-<n>, laid out in their own image of square tiles, never on the wall
servers are numbered fleet-wide; the header names the first host's server
a server up at the start is timed from its own report, to its bots' first chunk; players join only a wss:// DNS name

expect.note: a copy still being made is not a source
the copy runs: it is the last fork, and its assignment no longer asks for one

the next server wraps to the host's first
a reset before the copy ran drops the fork: the server restores from the gold snapshot
a borrow names its viewer as the server's driver; the server keeps its launch
no driver can be named in a claim

expect.note: reset all skips lent servers and drops a fork not yet run
a host clock behind the coordinator cannot put the first chunk before the click

checks./receipts/r8/reason: one reset all per 10 s per client

expect.note: the borrow ends: the server is reset for the next viewer

checks./receipts/c6/reason: your last server was returned 1 s ago; borrow again in 59 s

expect.note: a viewer that leaves gives its server back

checks./receipts/r9/reason: mc-4 is on a draining host

expect.note: a hello with fewer servers drops the rest
no servers, no minecraft in the state
a host that comes back gets the lowest free numbers
